desc:
<A:Q17> is typically played if Black wants to take back the corner territory. However, White will receive compensation on the outside. This is also the move to punish White if they forgot to read the [ladder](33344).

<B:R15> is a strong move that can be used to take the outside or provoke a complicated fight for the corner. In some circumstances, it can result in a trade where White sacrifices the corner for influence.

<C:S15> and <D:P16> prioritize development of the outside.
